title: GTA 6 won't stream to PC, Xbox says ☁️
subject: gta6
description:
Were you hoping to stream GTA 6 on PC? 👇

On October 6, 2026, The Verge reported that Xbox had exclusive cloud streaming rights for GTA 6 at launch, which would have let PC players stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming. On October 7, Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball called it "misreporting" and said the game "will not be streaming exclusively or to PC." GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Matthew Ball on X (Oct 7, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 6, 2026), Forbes (Oct 7, 2026), VICE (Oct 7, 2026)
